method: Source pages and their licensing sections actually read using the available web-reading tool. Downloads then inspected as real photographic files. This records observations, not a grant invented by the application.

sources.author: Yutaka Tsutano
sources.observation: The source page identifies a real Fender Mexico Stratocaster photograph and carries a CC attribution2.0 license; the Flickr license was reviewed at Commons upload.

sources.author: Joachim Hensel-Losch; Tkgd2007 and Hohum derivatives
sources.observation: The source page permits CCshare-alike3.0 under its multiple-license choice and identifies the photographer and retouched history.

sources.author: Martin Möller; derivative by Mouh2jijel
sources.observation: The source page identifies the derivative from a real classical-guitar photograph and assigns CCshare-alike2.0Germany. Source file RGBA transparency was inspected.

sources.author: Patrick Scales; derivative by Djhé
sources.observation: The source page dedicates the derivative and underlying photo to the public domain, identifies a 1970s Jazz Bass photograph and records a prior publisher color/PNG alteration.

cordobaLogo.observation: The guidelines distinguish textual product references from designed logos; designed-mark use requires a suitable agreement, and promotional use is restricted. No suitable agreement or unrestricted logo grant was available. Existing honest typography remains; no official mark is fabricated.
